page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-4x.8xlarge is a multi-accelerator instance within the Compute Optimized with GPU family, engineered for compute-heavy visual and artificial intelligence workloads. Running under the KVM hypervisor on x86_64 architecture, the instance provides 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at a 2.9 GHz base frequency. It incorporates 128 GB of system memory, establishing a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation of 4.0 GB per core.

Graphics and acceleration capabilities are supplied by four dedicated NVIDIA A10 GPUs, totaling 96 GB of VRAM across the hardware array. Network throughput is provisioned with a 32 Gbps baseline bandwidth, facilitating rapid data transfers for multi-GPU streaming and distributed ingestion pipelines. The instance provisions no local ephemeral storage, meaning operating system images and persistent datasets must reside on remote network-attached storage volumes. Complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included with the configuration.

From an infrastructure efficiency standpoint, pairing four discrete A10 accelerators within a single 32-vCPU node minimizes host virtualization overhead and maximizes density for concurrent GPU processing tasks. However, the lack of integrated local NVMe storage requires careful management of network storage throughput to prevent input/output bottlenecks during high-throughput ingest phases. The instance is well suited for multi-stream AI inference, real-time video transcoding, cloud workstation rendering, 3D visualization, and GPU-accelerated numerical simulation.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-4x.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance designed for graphics-intensive tasks and distributed machine learning inference. Built on the x86_64 architecture using KVM virtualization, it provides 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by 2.9 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processors alongside 128 GB of system memory, maintaining a 4.0 GB per vCPU ratio. Acceleration is driven by four bundled NVIDIA A10 GPUs providing a combined 96 GB of VRAM. The instance features a 32 Gbps baseline network interface to sustain fast multi-node communications and external storage traffic, as no local storage is included. Lacking onboard NVMe disks, all storage requirements rely on networked block storage. The multi-GPU density delivers efficient resource consolidation for deep learning inference servers, cloud workstation streaming, 3D visualization, video transcoding, and parallel computational workloads that demand high graphics acceleration alongside substantial host processing capacity.
